vg_brother.name: Unsleeping Brother
vg_brother.desc: A Brother of the Open Eye in a grey habit, lucid and exhausted, his lids propped open by habit alone. He knows exactly how many days it has been. He is very polite about it.

moves.name: Measure
moves.tell: takes your measure with the long staff

moves.name: Unblinking Gaze
moves.tell: does not blink

moves.name: Vigil Strike
moves.tell: raises the long staff

moves.name: Count the Hours
moves.tell: counts under his breath and stands very still

vg_sentinel.name: Armillary Sentinel
vg_sentinel.desc: An armillary sphere on three brass legs, its rings turning in their gimbals, walking the halls to check that nobody has fallen asleep. A paper tag on its lowest ring reads NIGHT PORTER, in a hand that has since been crossed out.

moves.name: Ring Strike
moves.tell: swings two rings at once

moves.name: Align
moves.tell: its rings begin to align. CONVERGENCE is coming

moves.name: Spin Up
moves.tell: its rings spin up and blur

Convergence.name: Convergence
Convergence.tell: is perfectly aligned. CONVERGENCE is coming

vg_glare.name: Heliograph Glare
vg_glare.desc: A relay mirror on a brass stalk that has learned to turn itself, gathering the day into a hot white coin. It has signalled the same flash across the dark for fifty years, and nobody has answered.

moves.name: Flash
moves.tell: tilts, and the whole room flares

moves.name: Burning Beam
moves.tell: narrows its light to a line

moves.name: Focus
moves.tell: gathers every mirror into one point. SUNBEAM is coming

Sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
Sunbeam.tell: is one white point. SUNBEAM is coming

vg_star.name: Fallen Star
vg_star.desc: A star that came down through the open Dome and could not find the way back up: a white thing the size of a hound, trailing a little cold smoke. It gives off a cold that burns.

moves.name: Streak
moves.tell: draws a line of light across the room

moves.name: Nova
moves.tell: swells and whitens

moves.name: Cold Fire
moves.tell: leans toward your flame, shivering

vg_blind_spot.name: Blind Spot
vg_blind_spot.desc: The patch a too-bright light leaves in the eye. In the Vigil the afterimages stayed, grew edges, and have started to hunger for the light that made them.

moves.name: Smother
moves.tell: closes over the light like a hand

moves.name: Swallow Light
moves.tell: leans in, and your flame dims

moves.name: Void
moves.tell: the dark inside it opens

vg_cellar_dead.name: Wakeful Dead
vg_cellar_dead.desc: A Brother who died on watch and would not lie down. The body kneels by a shuttered window with its eyes wide open. Whatever is left behind them has not slept either.

moves.name: Grave Measure
moves.tell: lifts a hand, palm out, as if to stop you

moves.name: Open Eyes
moves.tell: turns its whole face toward you

moves.name: Long Vigil
moves.tell: stares until you feel it

vg_orrery.name: The Great Orrery

stances.name: Sun-line
stances.msg: {hollow}The inner rings lock to the Sun-line.{/}

vg_orrery.desc: A model of the sky as large as a chapel, its rings turning in their own weather. It has been counting the days since the Signal was lent, and it is very proud of the number. A bronze iris-key hangs at its centre, where the Sun should be.

moves.name: Planet Strike
moves.tell: sends a planet round on its wire

moves.name: Wandering Star
moves.tell: a planet slips its wire

moves.name: Eclipse
moves.tell: swings one ring between you and the light

moves.name: Conjunction
moves.tell: its rings begin to align. GREAT CONJUNCTION is coming

Great Conjunction.name: Great Conjunction
Great Conjunction.tell: is aligned, every ring. GREAT CONJUNCTION is coming

phases.msg: The inner rings spin up. The outer rings counter-spin. The whole sky is going round.

moves.name: Planet Strike
moves.tell: sends a planet round on its wire

moves.name: Wandering Star
moves.tell: a planet slips its wire

moves.name: Eclipse
moves.tell: swings one ring between you and the light

moves.name: Conjunction
moves.tell: its rings begin to align. GREAT CONJUNCTION is coming

moves.name: Precession
moves.tell: the rings whirl, each at its own speed

vg_prior_eye.name: The Unsleeping Eye
vg_prior_eye.desc: A lens thirty feet across in a drum of brass and glass, the Order's great instrument and the Prior who bound himself to it. Inside the glass, if you look, a face. It has not blinked since the Signal was lent.

moves.name: Gaze
moves.tell: fixes you with the whole lens

moves.name: Burning Focus
moves.tell: narrows the light to a point

moves.name: Sweep the Sky
moves.tell: begins to turn, slowly, all the way round

moves.name: Open the Dome
moves.tell: the Dome shutters roll back

moves.name: Count the Stars
moves.tell: counts under its breath, and a star comes down

moves.name: Noon
moves.tell: the lens whitens. NOON is coming

phases.msg: The shutters of the Dome roll back. Starlight pours in, and the Eye turns it into daylight.

moves.name: Gaze
moves.tell: fixes you with the whole lens

moves.name: Burning Focus
moves.tell: narrows the light to a point

moves.name: Sweep the Sky
moves.tell: begins to turn, slowly, all the way round

moves.name: Daylight
moves.tell: the whole Dome fills with white

moves.name: Noon at Midnight
moves.tell: the lens whitens. NOON AT MIDNIGHT is coming

moves.name: Count the Stars
moves.tell: counts under its breath, and a star comes down

phases.msg: Inside the glass, a face: the Prior, eyelids stitched with starlight. 'How many nights was that? Has the signal come?'

moves.name: Prior's Vow
moves.tell: grips the mount and will not be moved

moves.name: Noon at Midnight
moves.tell: the lens whitens. NOON AT MIDNIGHT is coming

moves.name: Unblinking
moves.tell: will not close

moves.name: Gaze
moves.tell: fixes you with the whole lens

flavour: The Dome is half-shuttered, the Eye clouded. Behind the glass something is nodding, very slowly, forward.
The Eye turns sluggishly, and every few seconds it blinks without meaning to.
The Eye is open and bright and exactly as the Order left it: every lens aligned, every ring in place.
Starlight is drawn to it in a hum. The brass rings are moving faster than brass should.
The Eye is white. It is not a light you are looking at; it is a light looking at you.
